title: D-VLC: Joint Iteration of the System and Research Workflow
method: Read-only audit of archived reports, traces, code snapshots and video. No robotics or model experiment rerun for this article.

full_visual_pair.protocol: Same original two-floor layout, unknown initial objects and map; same 416 recorded code files, prompts, schemas and permissions. Online observations subsequently diverged. One run per model.
caveats: Single pair; not a general model ranking.
No adopted concurrency review revision in either run.
Skill attempts include exploration, failure and cancellation.
Stationary intervals include useful manipulation and sustained interaction.

semantic_protocol: No initially known objects or completed receipts. Simulator directly supplies visibility-gated semantic identities and positions. No online RGB recognition. Local maps built from simulated LiDAR. Not directly comparable with the recent visual pipeline.

known_state_demo.routine_discovery: initially disabled; new product can trigger local recognition

limitations: Entire saving cannot be attributed to final retained pickup reordering alone.
A subsequent 896.095-second full run completed but did not trigger the new pickup preparation feature.
predictive_candidate_pair.retained: Nearby pickup and direct release reordering
predictive_candidate_pair.removed: Idle physical preposition waiting points; a separate test blocked a teammate route.

reference_image_component_test.limitations: Small same-scene labeled replay with selected positives; not blind generalization.

media_editing.camera_views: Cropped, resized original footage; camera views sampled at 12 fps, output encoded at 25 fps. No new simulation.
media_editing.status: English labels from the corresponding archived telemetry, sampled once per video second.
media_editing.chinese_edition: Chinese labels from the same recorded telemetry; no simulator or model reruns.
media_editing.original_window_recordings: Five unmodified original Chinese-interface 3x recordings. SHA256 and protocol: assets/archive/manifest.json
media_editing.highlight_clips: Six continuous 3x excerpts: two original-window visual-recognition clips and four English camera-remaster clips. Event times and offsets: assets/highlights/manifest.json
media_editing.focused_event_views: Six annotated local stills and continuous clips; assets/focus/manifest.json
media_editing.gpt6_camera_remaster: The GPT-6 Astra medium 738.2-second demo is reframed as four enlarged third-person cameras; the pink mini-maps are omitted. Recorded shared-plan active subtasks replace per-robot action descriptions beneath the cameras. Original full-window archival recording is unchanged; SHA256/crop details in assets/gpt6-camera-remaster.json.
